text: FAQs for NATIONAL SCHOLARSHIP FOR POSTGRADUATE STUDIES 1 . What is NSPG Scheme? Reply: National Scholarship for Post Graduate Studies (NSPGS) is an umbrella scheme by merging four diﬀerent scholarship schemes for postgraduate studies i.e. (i) PG Indira Gandhi single girl child scholarship, (ii) PG scholarship for university rank holders, (iii) PG scholarship for SC/ST students pursuing professional courses and (iv) Post Graduate Scholarship for GATE/GPAT. 2 . How can I apply online for scholarship? Reply: Students can apply online through National Scholarship Portal (NSP). 3 . Does reservation system is followed in this scholarship? If yes what percentage is reserved for each respective category? Reply : Yes. The slots are allocated as per Govt. of India reservation policy. However, 30% slots will be reserved for the women candidates. Preference is given to single girl child. 4 . What is the definition of Single Girl Child? Reply: A 'Single Girl Child' is deﬁned as the only girl child in the family without any brothers or sisters. If a family has one or more sons and one daughter, the daughter is not considered a single girl child. However, a girl scholar who is one of the twin daughters or fraternal daughters is eligible to apply for the scholarship. 5 . Can Student apply in the PG Scholarship when he has enrolled in Integrated programme? Reply: Yes, the student can apply. In case of integrated programmes, the scholarship shall be given for PG component only. 6 . How may slots are available in PG Studies? Reply: Ten thousand (10000) slots per annum. 7 . What is the amount of PG scholarship? Reply: The rate of Rs.15,000/- per month for 10 months in a year. 8 . How many slots are reserved for women candidates? Reply: 30% slots will be reserved for the women candidates. Preference is given to single girl child. 9 . Those students who have completed PG degree and want to do PG again, can they still apply? Reply: Students, who have already acquired any postgraduate degree, are not eligible to apply. 10 . Is there any age criteria for this scholarship? Reply: Only students who are below the age of 30 years of age as on the date of admission in the first semester/year of a PG programme. 11 . Is there any income criteria for this scholarship? Reply: No 12 . Can students who are doing PG through distance mode apply for PG studies? Reply: No. This scholarship is for regular mode students only. 13 . If a student who gets another scholarship can apply for this scheme ? Reply: No, the students can avail only one scholarship at a time. 14 . What is the procedure of selection under this scholarship. Reply: 50% of slots are earmarked for Arts, Humanities and Social Sciences, Law, Management and other 50% are earmarked for Science, Engineering & Technology, medical, technical, agriculture, forestry programmes. The selection is done purely on merit basis. The slots are allocated as per Govt. of India reservation policy. However, 30% slots will be reserved for the women candidates. Preference is given to single girl child. 15 . How many times applications are invited in a year? Reply: Applications are invited once in a year on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP). 16 . Is it necessary to have AISHE code for university or college? Reply: Yes, it is mandatory for the University/College/Institute to have a valid AISHE code for accessing the National Scholarship Portal (NSP). The institution with AISHE code can get themselves registered on NSP portal through District/State nodal officers for NSP. 17 . I have submitted the application. Am I eligible to receive the scholarship? Reply: After submission of application, the same is veriﬁed ﬁrst by INO and then the SNO. Thereafter, the merit is prepared. The student is eligible for scholarship only if he/she is selected in the merit list. 18 . What is the procedure of scholarship disbursement. Reply: The scholarship amount is disbursed by UGC through DBT (Direct Beneﬁt Transfer) Mode and transferred to the Bank account which is seeded with Aadhaar. 19 . How to know the deadlines for application submission and verification of application at Institute/District/State Level? Reply: The deadlines for application submission and veriﬁcation are displayed on NSP. 20 . How to know the contact details of various Nodal Officers? Reply : The Scheme wise details of Nodal Oﬃcers is available under the Public Link of the NSP Portal. 21 . Which students can apply for renewal in NSPG . Reply: The scholarship are renewed for the next year of study on successful completion of ﬁrst year of study. The students are required to apply for ‘Renewal’ of their scholarship on the NSP. Scholarship for 2 nd year will not be processed without successful submission of renewal application. 22 . Can students edit the application after closing date? Reply: No, student cannot edit the application after closing date. Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. Only veriﬁed online applications will be considered for award of scholarship. 23 . Can the application be cancelled after verification by the institute? Reply: The application may be canceled if the student or institution provides wrong/misleading information on the portal.
